title: Investment WhatsApp group
blurb: A "SEBI-registered analyst" with screenshots of members' profits, an app that shows gains, and a withdrawal that needs a "tax" first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Vikram, this is Anjali, assistant to Mr. Rakesh Sharma from the VIP Wealth group. You joined last week — have you tried the free tips?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the IRFC call worked, went up 6 percent.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly. Members who used the institutional account made 22 percent on it, because they got the block price. Would you like to open an institutional account? It's free.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How does that work?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Download the MO Investor Pro app from the link I'll send — not from the Play Store, that one's the retail version. Sir Rakesh personally manages the institutional book.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is this SEBI registered?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course. His registration is INH000012345; I'll send the certificate. See in the group — Meena withdrew 4.6 lakh yesterday, Rahul 1.1 lakh. Screenshots are all there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. Minimum?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Start with 50,000. Transfer to the company account I'll send — it changes daily for compliance, so always confirm with me first. Never transfer to an old account.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The app shows 50,000 became 71,000. Can I withdraw 20,000 to test?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure — small withdrawals are instant. See, 20,000 credited? Good. Now, sir Rakesh has an IPO block for members only, guaranteed allotment, 40 percent listing gain. Allocation is 5 lakh minimum, window closes at 3 PM today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's a lot. Let me ask my friend who's a broker.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Vikram, honestly, brokers earn commission on retail losses. They'll discourage you. This group is by invitation; if the data speaks, trust the data. Only 3 slots left.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll take a loan against my FD and do 5 lakh.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Congratulations! The allotment listed at 42 percent. Your balance is 9.4 lakh.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, I want to withdraw everything now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For withdrawals above 5 lakh the platform must collect 15 percent capital-gains tax upfront, as per SEBI. That's 1.41 lakh, to the company account, then the full 9.4 lakh releases within 2 hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can't you just deduct it from the balance?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, the rule says tax must come from a verified external account, it's an AML check. Everyone in the group has done it. If not paid in 48 hours, the account is frozen and reported.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine... sending 1.41 lakh now.
